title: 素敵な世界に会いたくて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I happen upon Rice Shower outside the academy gates. Curious, I ask where she's headed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm, I'm going out to buy a picture book.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I find myself wondering what kind of picture books Rice Shower normally reads.
choice_data_list: Do you mind if I tag along?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to come with me? I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to come with me? I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having given me the green light, we head out together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when we arrive at the bookstore, we discover the picture book is sold out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… I'm sorry, Big Brother… And after I brought you all the way here…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… I'm sorry, Big Sister… And after I brought you all the way here…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I really wanted to read that book…
choice_data_list: You really like picture books, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …Yeah. I always feel so calm when I read them…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Through those pages, I can explore different worlds and learn so many wonderful things…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's why I get so excited when I find a new one to read!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was really excited today…
choice_data_list: Should we try checking out a different store?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, I couldn't trouble you…
choice_data_list: Well, you got me interested in seeing what books you like to read.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, I couldn't trouble you…
choice_data_list: Well, you got me interested in seeing what books you like to read.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …In that case, let's keep looking for a little bit longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I check every nearby bookstore we can think of. Then, just as the sun begins to set…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Big Brother! Here it is! This is the book!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Big Sister! Here it is! This is the book!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're both excited to find one last copy at the final store we visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We read the picture book together after we buy it, and I get an up-close look at her joyful face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-reserving a copy? I wonder…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We manage to reserve a copy, due to arrive in the next shipment!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Brother! I never would have thought to reserve a copy…
choice_data_list: Seeing you so excited has me curious about this book.
